scriptOverride.reason: wouldInterrupt's when clause compares event.card against source.parent (the attached character), not source itself, so the event.card 'isSelf' convention doesn't apply, and it also calls source.allowGameAction for a legality check not modeled by the vocabulary. Its cancel gameAction additionally substitutes a replacementGameAction (discard this attachment instead of the character leaving play) - a cancel-and-replace shape beyond the schema's plain cancel() handler.
